column3: Upon any of the U-Haul AREC RW Portfolio Whole Loan, the Birch Run Premium Outlets Whole Loan, the Houston Multifamily Portfolio Whole Loan, the Landstown Commons Whole Loan or the Park Center Plaza I, II, III Whole Loan becoming a specially serviced loan under the BMO 2026-C14 PSA, the related Non-Serviced Special Servicer thereunder will earn a special servicing fee payable monthly with respect to such Whole Loan accruing at a rate equal to the greater of 0.25% per annum and the rate that would result in a special servicing fee of $5,000 for the related month.
